scope: Residual ICC domain metadata and explicit matrix-component application. This does not enable native residual PCM playback or qualify LD phase/source dispatch.

original_iso_parameter_reference.quantization_metadata: Independently generated known mode/coarse schedule; coarse metadata is not dumped by the C oracle.
original_iso_parameter_reference.legacy_api: Same fine values and decoder state as decode_with_quantization.

matrix_controls.oracle: Separately encoded ordinary fine control streams, using owned qualified matrix assembly; not an independent full decoder.

compressed_candidate: All native candidate spatial frames are separately parsed; compressed residual ICC maps raw4 plus difference3 to index7 and value-0.99, preserving raw syntax/history. Native playback remains a separate refusal test.
lifecycle: Coarse/fine paired and unpaired sets, hold/default transitions
Exact C index and bit-consumption comparison
Late invalid corrections preserve parser/smoothing/matrix contexts and caller cursor
generation: Own generation is byte-identical with socket/process APIs denied. External C extraction is explicit and separate from tests. Frozen tests need no FFmpeg, compiler or network.
